description: One row of the ERP shift calendar (`/api/calendar` -> `week_pattern`): department x ISO weekday x shift, with the working-time window and its breaks. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/shift-window.md, description.

isa95.note: One recurring entry of the plant WorkCalendar (B2MML WorkCalendar / WorkCalendarEntry). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/shift-window.md, isa95 › note.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Department the window belongs to. Measured population 2026-08-03: LAGER | MECH | MONTAGE | SG. NOT declared as an enum: the plant may add a department without a schema change, and a consumer must never treat an unknown department as 'not scheduled'. Part of the composite key.

attributes.name: day_of_week
attributes.description: ISO-8601 weekday, 1=Monday .. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/shift-window.md, attributes › day_of_week › description.

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Shift code as the ERP names it. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/shift-window.md, attributes › shift_id › description.

attributes.name: start_time
attributes.description: Window start on the PLANT CLOCK as HH:MM:SS. No date and no timezone — this is a weekly pattern, not an instant. A consumer applies it in the same clock it attributes buckets in (golden-shift: tzOffsetMinutes, default 0 = UTC).

attributes.name: end_time
attributes.description: Window end on the plant clock as HH:MM:SS. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/shift-window.md, attributes › end_time › description.

attributes.name: break_minutes
attributes.description: Unpaid break minutes inside the window. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/shift-window.md, attributes › break_minutes › description.
